core_obligations: Sobriety and generic point: the space is sober by the sobriety proposition, and being irreducible it has a unique generic point (proof lines 10660-10664)
Open gerbe: there is a dense open substack which is a gerbe over an algebraic space, whose base is decent and has irreducible space (proof lines 10665-10672)

Integrality of the base: since the gerbe is reduced and the structure morphism is flat surjective and of finite presentation, the base equals its reduction, hence is an integral algebraic space, and after shrinking it may be assumed to be an integral scheme (proof lines 10673-10683)
proof_roadmap: 由 decent-sober 命题 |X| sober；又不可约 ⇒ 唯一泛点。
由开层命题得稠密开子栈 U ⊂ X，它是代数空间 U 上的 gerbe；U 是 decent（gerbe-decent + U decent）。
|U| = |U| 不可约；又 U 既约而 U → U 平坦满局部有限表现 ⇒ U = U_red ⇒ U 是整代数空间 ⇒ 缩到开子空间可设 U 是整概型。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an integral algebraic stack has a sober irreducible space with a unique generic point, and contains a dense open substack which is a gerbe over an integral scheme (author lemma at source lines 10650-10658, label lemma-structure-integral-stack). The proof (source lines 10660-10684) applies the sobriety proposition, takes the dense open gerbe supplied by the open stratum result, argues that its base is decent with irreducible space, that reducedness of the gerbe forces the base to be reduced and hence integral, and finally shrinks the base to an integral scheme (proof lines 10660-10683). The reducedness argument on the base is the substance. H3.
